questions.stem: A transversal crosses two parallel lines. One of the corresponding angles is $72°$. What is the other corresponding angle?
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles formed by a transversal crossing parallel lines are equal. Both angles are $72°$.

questions.stem: Which pair of angles formed by a transversal crossing parallel lines are equal?
questions.explanation: Alternate angles (sometimes called Z-angles) are equal when formed by a transversal crossing parallel lines. Co-interior angles are supplementary (sum to $180°$), not equal.

questions.stem: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. A pair of co-interior angles are $x$ and $125°$. What is $x$?
questions.explanation: Co-interior (allied) angles between parallel lines are supplementary, so $x + 125° = 180°$, giving $x = 55°$.
